name: KENT Gold
summary: KENT Gold UF Water Purifier is a non-electric, gravity-based water purifier featuring a 0.1-micron Ultra Filtration membrane that removes bacteria and cysts without chemicals while retaining essential minerals.
intro: The KENT Gold UF Water Purifier is an advanced non-electric, gravity-based water purifier designed specifically for homes receiving low TDS tap water or municipal corporation water supply. It utilizes Ultra Filtration (UF) technology with a 0.1-micron hollow fibre hydrophilic membrane that effectively removes bacteria, cysts, and other disease-causing microorganisms without the use of electricity or chemicals.
features: Advanced UF Purification Technology with 0.1-micron hollow fibre membrane
Removes bacteria, cysts, and suspended impurities
Chemical-Free Purification – No chlorine, bromine, or iodine used
Preserves Essential Natural Minerals in water
20-Litre Storage Tank for continuous water availability
Ideal for Low TDS Tap & Municipal Water Supply
